query: Which psychometric steps (EFA/CFA, reliability, rater-style checks) and sample-size targets are required to validate a perceived-creativity battery and meta-sensemaking rubric?

response.query: Which psychometric steps (EFA/CFA, reliability, rater-style checks) and sample-size targets are required to validate a perceived-creativity battery and meta-sensemaking rubric?
response.answer: To validate a perceived-creativity battery and meta-sensemaking rubric, conduct exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis (EFA/CFA), assess reliability, and perform rater-style checks. A sample size of at least 200 participants is typically recommended.
